title: Teddington Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical locations, urgent treatment centres, and hazard guidance for Teddington and Hampton Wick.
content: For immediate life-threatening emergencies, always dial 999 or 112 first. 1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals: Kingston Hospital, Galsworthy Road, Kingston upon Thames KT2 7QB (from Hampton Wick station: ~20 min walk east across Kingston Bridge and along Kingston Hill / Galsworthy Road, or from Teddington station: bus 281 or 285 to Kingston). West Middlesex University Hospital, Twickenham Road, Isleworth TW7 6AF (from Teddington station: bus 281 north through Twickenham, then bus 267). For designated Major Trauma care, the regional centre is St George's Hospital, Blackshaw Road, Tooting, London SW17 0QT. 2. Urgent Treatment Centres: Teddington Memorial Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre, Hampton Road, Teddington TW11 0JL (from Teddington station: ~10 min walk west along Broad Street and Hampton Road). 3. Area Hazards: The River Thames runs along Teddington and Hampton Wick; the tidal limit ends at Teddington Lock. Low-lying riverside sections along Ferry Road, Broom Road, and Hampton Wick riverside paths are subject to tidal surge and fluvial flooding. 4. Supplies: Supermarkets and chemists situated along Teddington High Street, Broad Street, and Hampton Wick High Street supply bottled drinking water, first-aid equipment, and vital medications during utility cuts. Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
